newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Nampak cut to outperform.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Nampak cut to outperform.

text.p: -- Smith Barney said on Thursday it had cut its rating on South African packaging company Nampak Ltd to outperform-medium risk from buy-medium risk.
-- The downgrade came as a result of continuing weakness in the South African rand, analyst Martin Feldman said in a report.
-- "Despite rand-based earnings per share growth of 14 percent in fiscal '96, U.S. dollar EPS growth declined by four percent," he said.

-- "Nampak's earnings are substantially based on rand revenues, and we do not expect total 12-month returns to exceed 20 percent. Rather, we forecast total 12-month U.S. dollar returns of 13 percent, hence our revised ... rating."
